claim_boundary: This is a development-set representation diagnostic on the existing frozen ten-record, ten-functional-group MNSol panel. It compares a previously evaluated MACE-POLAR fixed l<=1 source with one fixed gas-phase QM AO density and the same density projected into a SALTED-compatible RI Gaussian basis. The RI arm is a representation upper bound, not a learned SALTED prediction. The run cannot certify SALTED model accuracy, blind generalization, original-SMD equivalence, self-consistent polarization, forces, geometry relaxation, a smooth solution-phase PES, conformer ensembles, or a production default.

decision_rule.failure: Any Git cleanliness, dataset, selection, geometry, baseline-artifact, SCF convergence, closed-shell electron-count, finite-value, RI raw-charge, RI projected-charge, surface-parity, provider-version, or completeness gate failure invalidates the run. No density method, basis, auxiliary basis, equation, radius, dielectric, grid, CDS value, record, or threshold may be changed after observing full-panel outcomes.
decision_rule.interpretation: AO-versus-RI differences estimate loss from the SALTED-compatible RI representation. MACE-versus-AO/RI differences also contain density-model and electronic-structure differences and cannot be attributed only to angular truncation. Rankings are descriptive for this bounded development panel.
decision_rule.success: All ten gas-phase QM densities and all sixty new frozen-density continuum evaluations complete under the locked gates, while the thirty existing MACE fixed-l1 method ledgers are rebound from the immutable baseline artifact. Emit one private row-level artifact and one public aggregate-only artifact.

metrics.timing: QM SCF, AO MEP, RI fit, RI MEP, continuum build, continuum solve, and shared CDS wall times are recorded separately. QM-oracle time is not a learned SALTED inference benchmark.

numerics.cavity_radii: frozen per-solvent PySCF-2.13.1 SMD Coulomb radii from the baseline artifact and recomputed for equality
numerics.dielectric: route2_solvent_spec canonical static dielectric for each solvent
numerics.nonpolar_model: PySCF 2.13.1 SMD-CDS, recomputed and required to match the frozen baseline artifact
numerics.ri_charge_constraint: Coulomb-metric minimum correction to the exact closed-shell electron count

privacy.row_level_output: must remain below .omx and must not be committed
privacy.single_record_smoke: both outputs must remain below .omx and are non-scientific engineering evidence

selection.functional_group_assignment: pre-existing post-selection descriptive labels; not selection criteria for this density diagnostic

solute_sources.representation: previously frozen gas MACE-POLAR atom-centred l<=1 coarse residual-charge multipoles
fixed gas-phase DF-RKS AO density evaluated directly on the PCM surface
the same DF-RKS AO density Coulomb-fitted into the SALTED-compatible auxiliary Gaussian basis with explicit charge projection
solute_sources.result_source: new SALTED representation upper bound, not learned SALTED inference
